result.instructions: Tools for Vultr, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our cloud instances are running, and in which regions?"; "What are our pending charges this month, and which resources cost the most?"; "Show the DNS records for our main domain.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vultr data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vultr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vultr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vultr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vultr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vultr_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the Vultr account: name, email, balance, pending charges and account limits. Vultr API: GET /v2/account.

tools.title: Get pending charges
tools.description: Show the charges that have built up since the last invoice, grouped by resource. Use it to see what the account costs now. Vultr API: GET /v2/billing/pending-charges.
